steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Television is one of the most influential media forms, combining visual, audio, and written codes to tell stories and communicate ideas to mass and niche audiences.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Traditional broadcast TV used scheduling to target audiences — primetime (7-10pm) for mass audiences, late night for niche content, daytime for specific demographics.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Streaming services (Netflix, Amazon Prime, Disney+) have disrupted traditional broadcasting — audiences can watch what they want, when they want, on any device.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: TV drama conventions: ensemble casts, multiple storylines, cliffhangers, series arcs, episodic and serial structures. Quality TV / 'peak TV' features cinematic production values.
